PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Public competitive statistics and display profile for an authenticated FiFA 2026 player. Contains no email or sensitive PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

goalsScored.description: Total goals scored in online matches.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

OnlineRoom.title: OnlineRoom
OnlineRoom.description: 1v1 online match room keyed by a unique 5-character room code (e.g. A7K92). Tracks lobby membership, club selection, and immutable final result.

roomCode.description: 5-character uppercase alphanumeric room code matching the document ID.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator (Home side).

hostName.description: Public display name of the host.

hostTeamId.description: Club ID selected by the host.

hostFormation.description: Tactical formation selected by the host.

hostReady.description: Whether the host is ready to kick off.

guestUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the joining opponent (Away side), or empty string while waiting.

guestName.description: Public display name of the guest, or empty string while waiting.

guestTeamId.description: Club ID selected by the guest (always distinct from hostTeamId once joined).

guestFormation.description: Tactical formation selected by the guest.

guestReady.description: Whether the guest is ready to kick off.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the match room.

winnerUid.description: UID of the winning player when finished, or empty string for draw/in-progress.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when room was created.

updatedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when room was last updated.

/players/{uid}.description: Authenticated player public stats profile. Only readable by authenticated players by exact UID (no collection list); only writable by the owner UID.

/rooms/{roomCode}.description: Online 1v1 match room keyed by 5-character room code. Supports exact-code lookup while waiting, participant-only updates with strict field whitelists, and terminal lock once finished.
